name: iroh-do-echo-server
description: The echo app as a TypeScript Durable Object on iroh-do

scripts.build: npm --prefix ../../.. run build -w iroh-do && iroh-do-bundle --config wrangler.toml --outdir dist
scripts.check: npm run types && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && vitest run --project e2e
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
